scene.s: Six powerful applications unified into one seamless platform — from dashboards to data pipelines to agentic solutions, all powered by Aiden, your DART AI intelligence agent.
Ask Aiden how to get started…
Access specialised tools for every aspect of your data journey, all from one seamless platform.
The control hub for all your data analytics and reporting needs. Build dashboards, create reports and unlock insights with AI.
Automatically generate comprehensive documentation, meeting notes and knowledge bases from your data and conversations.
Discover patterns, explore data relationships and uncover hidden insights across all your data sources.
Machine learning and predictive modelling. Forecast trends, detect anomalies and predict outcomes with AI.
Advanced data transformation and pipeline orchestration. Turn raw data into actionable insights automatically.
Internal team workspace for collaboration, governance and compliance. Manage permissions, audit trails and team workflows.
What industry leaders say about DART Central.
DART has completely transformed how we approach data analytics. The AI-powered insights save us hours every week.
The unified platform approach means our team no longer has to juggle multiple tools. It is a game-changer.
VP of Data Engineering, DataFlow Inc
NoteGen’s natural-language querying makes data accessible to everyone, not just data scientists.
Enterprise-grade security, reliability and performance, trusted by teams worldwide.
Real-time collaboration across teams and departments.
Connect to 200+ data sources and databases.
REST APIs, SDKs and extensive documentation.
Automate reports, alerts and data pipelines.
Start with the app you need today. The rest are already waiting.
Six applications, one platform, one intelligence layer.
